evidence.quote: In a reversal of previous recessions, women suffered more from job losses in the COVID-19 recession than men.
it does not account for the many women who left the workforce entirely.

Long-standing disparities weigh on the productive capacity of our economy, which can only realize its full potential if everyone has a solid chance to contribute to, and to reap the benefits of, broad-reaching prosperity.
